text:
Maya: Quick check-in 10am PT We need final confirmations: speaker order, rehearsal slots, and which demo fallback we'll show publicly. Weekend buffer is tight so please respond here.

Priya: I can speak on cost/latency tradeoffs. Prefer Wed rehearsal 11am PT.

Ethan: I'll cover model selection & quantization recommendations. Available Tue afternoon.

Kevin: Ops needs a short (20m) blackout window during the full run to validate fallback routing to 'quantized-1.3b' and 'cpu-safe' variants. I'll need the exact test list.

Sarah: Draft abstract for public page: 
"Join Redwood engineers for a hands-on session about building resilient inference systems. We'll demonstrate batching strategies, cache-aware routing, and live failover patterns that keep apps serving during capacity events. Best for platform, infra, and ML engineers."

Maya: Love it. Two asks: add who should attend (seniority/roles) and a single-sentence takeaway.

Lucy: Ops for registrations: proposed lead tags -> [source:webinar, interest:demo, intent:high]. SFDC rule will auto-assign to Marketing_Growth and create a follow-up task if interest:demo. Any objections?

Alex: No objections. Also suggesting we add a short post-webinar nurture: 3-email drip with demo replay + quickstart template + invite to trials.

Priya: I drafted two subject line AB tests for the invite: 
A) "Low-latency inference patterns (practical playbook)"
B) "How to keep LLMs serving during spikes: batching & failovers"
Which should we push to 10% test cohort?

Maya: Run both. Track CTR + reg rate. Use cohort by company size.

Ethan: Rehearsal/run-of-show proposal (compact): 
00:00-00:04 Intro + goals (Maya)
00:04-00:16 Batching & throughput patterns (Ethan)
00:16-00:28 Cache routing + invalidation (Priya)
00:28-00:44 Live demo: routing + failover (Kevin + Alex)
00:44-00:48 CTA + product notes (Maya)
00:48-00:60 Q&A (all)

Kevin: Demo fallback script (high level): 
```
1) send steady traffic to staging endpoint
2) at t+30s, throttle primary GPU pool (simulate OOM/eviction)
3) verify automatic routing to quantized-1.3b
4) if that fails, fallback to cpu-safe endpoint and surface a warning banner
5) capture p50/p95, error rates, and token counts
```
I'll check in logs to ensure the UI banner triggers.

Lucy: Calendar invites: 
- Dry run (content only) 30m Thu 3pm PT
- Full run (infra + smoke) 45m Mon 9am PT
Invites sent and rehearsal doc linked: https://drive.redwood/inference/webinars/low-latency-practical

webinar-bot: Reminder Slides must be uploaded 48h before event. Add recording permission to the shared drive.

Priya: Small ops question what's the fallback messaging we show to users in the demo? Prefer: "Were routing to a compact variant to maintain responsiveness; you may notice slightly different outputs." Thoughts?

Sarah: That's good. Add a short note about potential output variance due to quantization.

Maya: Audience segmentation for invites: 
- Segment A: Platform/infra engineers (focus on failovers)
- Segment B: ML engineers (focus on batching/quantization)
Use different CTAs: "See demo" vs "Get quantization guide". Lucy, can marketing ops add UTM params: utm_campaign=llm-inference-2026&utm_source=invite&utm_variant=A/B ?

Lucy: Added UTM template and will populate for A/B sends. Also setting tracking on registration form to capture "primary_role" and "interest_level" fields.

Ethan: For the rehearsal, please include the exact curl tests I'll run so everyone knows the payload mix. Example: 
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/infer -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"short prompt","max_tokens":16}'
# repeat with 64 tokens and 512 tokens payloads, measure latencies
```
I'll drop a script in the drive.

Maya: Final checklist before EOD: 
- Priya/Ethan: speaker one-liners + headshots in the shared drive
- Kevin/Alex: demo playbook + smoke test script uploaded
- Lucy: SFDC routing + UTM templates confirmed
- Maya: finalize public registration blurb and A/B segments

Priya: Uploaded bios/headshots.

Kevin: Playbook and basic test results uploaded; will run full smoke during Monday rehearsal.

Lucy: SFDC + UTM done. Will share sample CSV of expected lead fields.

Maya: Thanks all I'll send the registration page copy in the morning and schedule the 10% AB send for cohort testing. :sparkles:
